basic_details.job_title: Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 contractual supportive staff posts in the Evening Court, Madhubani: one post each of Stenographer, Clerk and Peon / Orderly. The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani on or before 2 December 2026, either personally or through registered post. Only those who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, will be considered.

Governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani, and signed by Pawan Kumar Pandey, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani, on 17 November 2026. The staff will support the Evening Court, Madhubani. The notice is to be circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar, pasted on the notice board of the Nazarat, Civil Court, Madhubani, and uploaded on the website of the District Court, Madhubani.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani on or before 2 December 2026. The notice allows two ways to send it: Personally, by handing it in at the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani Through registered post, addressed to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani The date is for receipt, not dispatch, so an application sent by post must reach the office by 2 December 2026. The notice does not print a prescribed application form, a fuller postal address with PIN code, an envelope superscription or a list of documents to enclose.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired Court employees will be considered who have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the three posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post. No pay amount is printed. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the Evening Court, Madhubani: one each for Stenographer, Clerk and Peon / Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Madhubani Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani on or before 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Madhubani Evening Court supportive staff posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, will be considered. They must be physically and mentally fit, with satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q7. What is required for the Peon / Orderly post?
faq.answer: The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post, besides meeting the common conditions for retired Civil Court employees.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Madhubani Evening Court engagement a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. How will the remuneration be decided?
faq.answer: The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount is printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q10. When will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: The selected candidates shall perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court, Madhubani.
